name: Multi-object working memory in macaque frontal cortex
description: Supervised the conversion of a working memory study in rhesus monkeys that paired Neuropixels and V-probe recordings of frontal cortex with eye position, pupil size, reward and audio signals, aligning every stream to a common clock through recorded sync pulses.
Added automatic upload to the conversion, so the lab could convert and publish each session to the archive from their own computing cluster.
Resulted in the publication of a total **5.5 TB** of electrophysiology and behavioral data on the NIH data archive.
